n: <int> Number of nodes in the transportation network, each serving as an origin, destination, and candidate hub location.
num_scenarios: <int> Number of demand scenarios representing uncertain future conditions.

cost_parameters.chi: <float> Unit cost rate for shipping flow from an origin node to its assigned hub (collection leg).
cost_parameters.alpha: <float> Unit cost rate for shipping flow between two hubs (inter-hub transfer leg).
cost_parameters.delta: <float> Unit cost rate for shipping flow from a hub to a destination node (distribution leg).

p_hubs: <int or null> Exact number of hubs that must be opened in the p-hub median variant, or null if not applicable.
node_coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [n][2]> Geographic x-y coordinates of each node in the network.
distances: <list[list[float]], shape [n][n]> Euclidean distance between each pair of nodes.
base_demands: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Baseline number of shipments from each origin node to each destination node, with zero on the diagonal.
fixed_costs: <list[int], length n> One-time setup cost incurred when opening each candidate node as a hub.
hub_capacities: <list[int] or null, length n> Maximum total outgoing flow that each hub can handle in the capacitated variant, or null if uncapacitated.

scenarios.probability: <float> Likelihood of this demand scenario occurring.
scenarios.pi_factors: <list[float], length n> Multiplicative scaling factor applied to each node when generating scenario-specific demands.
scenarios.demands: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Number of shipments from each origin to each destination under this scenario, with zero on the diagonal.
